observe.server-busy-saved.en: Hawkeye is busy right now — your signed report is saved on this phone and sends automatically.
observe.server-busy-saved.ha: Hawkeye yana cike da aiki yanzu — an ajiye rahotonka mai sa hannu a wannan wayar, kuma zai tafi ta atomatik.
observe.server-busy-saved.ig: Hawkeye nọ n'ọrụ ugbu a — echekwara akụkọ gị e binyere aka n'ekwentị a, ọ ga-eziga onwe ya ozugbo.
observe.server-busy-saved.yo: Hawkeye ń ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ báyìí — a ti fi ìròyìn rẹ tí o fọwọ́sí pamọ́ sórí fóònù yìí, yóò sì ránṣẹ́ fúnra rẹ̀.

observe.server-busy-try-again.en: Hawkeye is busy — try again in a minute.
observe.server-busy-try-again.ha: Hawkeye yana cike da aiki — sake gwadawa nan da minti ɗaya.
observe.server-busy-try-again.ig: Hawkeye nọ n'ọrụ — nwaa ọzọ n'otu nkeji.
observe.server-busy-try-again.yo: Hawkeye ń ṣiṣẹ́ lọ́wọ́ — gbìyànjú lẹ́ẹ̀kan sí i ní ìṣẹ́jú kan.

dashboard.could-not-refresh-retrying.en: Could not refresh — trying again in 30 seconds.
dashboard.could-not-refresh-retrying.ha: An kasa sabuntawa — za a sake gwadawa nan da daƙiƙa 30.
dashboard.could-not-refresh-retrying.ig: Enweghị ike imelite — a ga-anwa ọzọ n'ime sekọnd 30.
dashboard.could-not-refresh-retrying.yo: Kò ṣeé ṣe láti sọ ọ́ di tuntun — a ó tún gbìyànjú ní ìṣẹ́jú-àáyá 30.

dashboard.latest-reports-note.en: Showing the latest {n} reports, newest first.
dashboard.latest-reports-note.ha: Ana nuna rahotanni {n} na baya-bayan nan, sabbi a farko.
dashboard.latest-reports-note.ig: Na-egosi akụkọ {n} kacha ọhụrụ, nke ọhụrụ na mbụ.
dashboard.latest-reports-note.yo: À ń fi àwọn ìròyìn {n} tó dé kẹ́yìn hàn, èyí tó tuntun jùlọ lákọ̀ọ́kọ́.
